XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Engine fault warning light comes on, with vehicle functioning correctly
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | P148C | P148B | P164E | P20EE | LIGHTS UP | ON | MIL | YELLOW | VALVE | ADJUSTMENT | PRESSURE | OIL | ENGINE |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Oil pressure control valve

  • Fault: The vehicle’s engine fault warning light is illuminated; the vehicle continues to run normally

  • Faults detected by the self-diagnostic system: P164E (Engine oil pressure valve – malfunction)

    Possible faults that may be detected but are not directly related to the device in question:
    • P148C (Particulate filter additive heater 2 – Fault)
    • P148B (Particulate filter additive heater 1 – Fault)
    • P20EE (NOx sensor, bank 1 – Low efficiency)
  • Cause: Faulty oil pressure control valve

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the valve and replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component is located between the engine and radiator, on the passenger side, connected to the engine block at approximately mid-height.
    The defective component did not show any visual abnormalities and, after its replacement, no adjustment using diagnostic equipment was necessary, definitively resolving the anomaly.
